answer: Because the horizon derivation is checked against the reef nonce, the copper audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 135 aliases produces 135 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 26 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
